name: unslop-ui
description: Cut AI tells from interface and chart copy: eyebrow labels, 01/02/03 numbering, redundant subtitles, captions that explain what is already visible, leaked design notes, decorative badges, icons and status dots, chart clutter and legends a direct label could replace. With --surface it also fixes gradients and glows, off-scale spacing, extra-heavy weights and decorative motion.
